rules.name: mig-recon-01-check
rules.sql: WITH ptr AS ( SELECT p.business_unit, p.view_type, p.settlement_date, p.published_run_id FROM opera.recon_snapshot_pointer p WHERE p.tenant_id = :tenant AND p.settlement_date = (SELECT max(p2.settlement_date) FROM opera.recon_snapshot_pointer p2 WHERE p2.tenant_id = p.tenant_id AND p2.business_unit = p.business_unit AND p2.view_type = p.view_type) ), cnt AS ( SELECT 'SETTLE_PRICING' AS view_type, s.run_id, s.business_unit, count(*) AS n FROM opera.recon_settle_snapshot s WHERE s.tenant_id = :tenant AND s.run_id IN (SELECT published_run_id FROM ptr WHERE view_type = 'SETTLE_PRICING') GROUP BY s.run_id, s.business_unit UNION ALL SELECT 'SETTLE_ACTUAL_PRICING', s.run_id, s.business_unit, count(*) FROM opera.recon_actual_snapshot s WHERE s.tenant_id = :tenant AND s.run_id IN (SELECT published_run_id FROM ptr WHERE view_type = 'SETTLE_ACTUAL_PRICING') GROUP BY s.run_id, s.business_unit UNION ALL SELECT 'TRADERS_PRICING', s.run_id, s.business_unit, count(*) FROM opera.recon_traders_snapshot s WHERE s.tenant_id = :tenant AND s.run_id IN (SELECT published_run_id FROM ptr WHERE view_type = 'TRADERS_PRICING') GROUP BY s.run_id, s.business_unit ), fixed AS ( SELECT l.business_unit, max(l.run_at) AS last_fix FROM opera.latest_active_lot_reconcile_log l WHERE l.tenant_id = :tenant AND l.repaired AND (l.missing + l.extra + l.different) > 0 GROUP BY l.business_unit ) SELECT p.business_unit, p.view_type, p.settlement_date::text AS settlement_date, rr.status, rr.row_count AS run_row_count, coalesce(c.n, 0) AS snapshot_rows, CASE WHEN rr.row_count IS NOT DISTINCT FROM coalesce(c.n, 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS rows_match, greatest(rr.completed_at, rr.updated_timestamp)::text AS built_at, f.last_fix::text AS last_cache_fix, CASE WHEN f.last_fix > greatest(rr.completed_at, rr.updated_timestamp) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS fixed_after_run FROM ptr p JOIN opera.recon_refresh_run rr ON rr.uuid = p.published_run_id LEFT JOIN cnt c ON c.run_id = p.published_run_id AND c.view_type = p.view_type AND c.business_unit = p.business_unit LEFT JOIN fixed f ON f.business_unit = p.business_unit ORDER BY p.business_unit, p.view_type

expect.reason: the stored rows equal the row count the run recorded
no snapshot is older than a latest_active_lot repair (rebuild with mig-recon-02-rebuild.json)

rules.sql: SELECT v.business_unit, max(v.value_date)::text AS valuation_date FROM opera.valuation_date_table v WHERE v.tenant_id = :tenant AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM opera.recon_snapshot_pointer p WHERE p.tenant_id = v.tenant_id AND p.business_unit = v.business_unit) GROUP BY v.business_unit ORDER BY 1
